description: This Java source file defines a final class 'RequestTimeoutHandlingDirective' which provides functionality to handle request timeouts within an Akka HTTP server. It includes methods for wrapping routes with timeout handling logic, logging timer metrics, and constructing timeout responses, mainly designed for an Eclipse Ditto gateway service.

classes.name: RequestTimeoutHandlingDirective
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to handle request timeouts in an Akka HTTP server, including timing, logging, and response generation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RequestTimeoutHandlingDirective with the provided HTTP configuration.

methods.name: handleRequestTimeout
methods.description: Wraps a route to add request timeout handling, including timing and logging.

methods.name: checkDurationWarning
methods.description: Logs warnings if request processing duration exceeds configured thresholds.

methods.name: doHandleRequestTimeout
methods.description: Generates a timeout HttpResponse, logs relevant information, and updates timers.
